svg.title: EDA Retail Lakehouse architecture
svg.desc: A Unity Catalog source table flows into Lakeflow, where Bronze, Silver and Gold layers are built, then into governed Gold tables. Genie and an MCP server read the Gold tables; a dashed MLflow model card is trained in a notebook and not served. A governance panel above lists Unity Catalog access controls, Delta quality checks and, dashed, dual-engine parity that lives in a notebook.
